relationships.evidence_quote: chondroitin sulfate proteoglycans (CSPGs) can act on the growth cone and effectively inhibit axon regeneration

relationships.subject: CSPGs
relationships.evidence_quote: CSPGs loaded in a gelatin blocker can prevent traumatic neuroma formation

key_findings: CSPG-gelatin blocker on the proximal nerve stump prevented bulb-shaped neuroma formation and reduced autotomy in rats
CSPG group had lower c-fos, substance P, IL-17 and IL-1beta
